title: Opening Your nsave Account
summary: How to open your nsave account smoothly, avoid document submission issues, and provide source of wealth information that meets requirements.
body_markdown:
### Protecting Your Account From Day One


The most common mistake: Digitally editing documents to improve clarity


Why this causes problems:


Digitally enhanced documents are rejected by our systems which triggers a manual review.


The solution: Submit original, unedited scans or photographs.


If your submission is rejected:


nsave will explain the rejection reason. Options for resubmission:


- Take a new photograph or scan with better lighting
- Provide a different document that meets requirements
- Submit updated documentation if information has changed


#### Source of Wealth Documentation: Verifiable Evidence


When nsave requests a source of wealth documentation, provide clear evidence of your source of income. ‍


Acceptable documentation for different income types:


- Employment: Most recent payslips, employment contract, or employer letter confirming salary
- Freelancing: Client invoices, service contracts, platform earnings statements (Upwork, Fiverr, etc.)
- Self-Employment: Business registration documents, recent tax returns, business bank statements
- Investments: Brokerage statements, investment account documentation
- Inheritance: Estate documentation or inheritance confirmation letter
- Savings: Bank statements showing accumulated balances over time ‍


Common mismatches that trigger additional review:


- Stated source of income doesn't match submitted documentation
- Income amounts in documentation don't align with stated monthly earnings
- Documentation is outdated ‍


If documentation cannot be verified, your account may be suspended or closed.
